title: Mantis being at the bedside tears flesh to show the body is a soul container

tellings.quote: triangle face opens up and these Jaws

plain: In 1995, at his home near Denver, Colorado, a mantis-like being stood at the bedside of John Blitch, a former DARPA scientist (DARPA being the Pentagon's research agency), and tore at flesh to show him that the body is only a container for the soul. Blitch tells Michels this as something he saw himself, describing how the creature's "triangle face opens up and these Jaws" appear.
